dimensions.mission: Keep data collection and owner reporting safe with two measured local repairs.
dimensions.flexibility_and_history: Additive built-in SQLite index; old writers remain compatible; no immutable history rewrite.
dimensions.context_efficiency: One bounded task, existing tools, focused tests and one CI resource loop.
dimensions.research_truth: Exact Python time cut, preserved UNKNOWN, verified immutable partitions, no cache between cycles.
dimensions.owner_operability: Backup-first index preparation, same stdlib kernel peak on canary/ordinary units, InvocationID readback, timer enable only after required checks.
dimensions.execution_to_cashflow: Collection continuity only; no alpha or cashflow claim.
dimensions.monitoring_and_recovery: Candidate CI resource proof plus separate real-host canaries and delivery; current disabled reports stay protected until commissioning.
dimensions.build_vs_buy: SQLite, ResearchStore and existing systemd only; no added dependency or monitoring service.
dimensions.security: No provider calls, secret values or payload output; synthetic history and GitHub delivery only.
dimensions.red_team: Old query reproduced, malformed/equal/future/edge time, mismatched index, old writer and cgroup false-PASS cases tested.

recovery: Exact-SHA code rollback remains writable with the added built-in index; keep report timers off on failed canary.
